title: Planar Atlas
description: Living maps for your campaign. A big map becomes an atlas scene with places as pins, each with a card (what the players know, what only the GM knows), shown to players only once they know about it. The party is a token you drag: every stop is recorded with the session and the in-world day, and drawn on the map as a numbered road until you archive it. Maps whose edges join (a city drawn in strips) are routed around. A party window for everyone: the road, a common purse with its history, and the party's own notes.

recommends.reason: The road, purse and notes pages become Codex notes that export to your vault.
A place's card shows its Theater place over the map with one click.
A place's card starts its soundscape.
